description: Send data to Kafka topics with support for both real-time streaming and batch processing

data_input.info: The data to send to Kafka. Accepts list of Data objects from upstream components.

bootstrap_servers.info: Comma-separated list of Kafka broker addresses (e.g., 'localhost:9092,localhost:9093')

topic.info: The Kafka topic to send messages to

key_field.info: Field name to use as message key. If specified, messages with the same key will go to the same partition.

value_serializer.info: How to serialize the message value

partition_key.info: Field to use for custom partitioning. Messages with the same partition key will be routed to the same partition.

headers.info: Custom headers to include with each message

compression_type.info: Compression algorithm to use for messages

batch_size.info: Number of messages to batch together for better performance

timeout_ms.info: Maximum time to wait for message delivery in milliseconds

acks.info: Number of acknowledgments the producer requires the leader to have received

retries.info: Number of times to retry sending failed messages

send_as_batch.info: Send messages in batches for better performance

result.info: Summary of messages sent to Kafka

errors.kafka_not_installed: confluent-kafka library is not installed. Install it with: pip install confluent-kafka
errors.send_failed: Failed to send messages to Kafka: {error}
errors.topic_not_found: Topic '{topic}' not found or not accessible

warnings.no_key_field: No key field specified. Messages will be distributed across partitions randomly.
warnings.large_batch_size: Large batch size may cause memory issues. Consider reducing it.
warnings.no_compression: No compression enabled. Consider enabling compression for better performance.
warnings.sasl_credentials_missing: SASL username provided but password is missing, or vice versa.
